title: Ready status and parts readiness
summary: This topic centers on ambiguous mentions of vehicle readiness indicators, driver-ready state, and uncertainty about when parts or the vehicle will be ready.

positive.summary: One positive-classified review discusses the vehicle being in the workshop and uncertainty about readiness and safe driving, so the positive evidence appears limited and contextually inconsistent.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the meaning of the 'Ready' display, lack of updates on parts readiness, and failure to leave the vehicle in a driver-ready state without enough context to infer clear sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are classified as undetermined, which limits confident interpretation of customer attitude.
The sample mixes dashboard 'Ready' display meaning, parts availability timing, and driver-ready state, which may reflect related but not fully coherent subjects.
The lone positive-classified example contains strongly negative wording, so the provided sentiment labels appear inconsistent with the text and should be interpreted cautiously.
